source_type: Official SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: SEARCA explicitly identifies the programme as fully funded and lists tuition and school fees, round-trip travel, thesis/dissertation support, books and supplies, health insurance, and stipend for food, lodging and incidental expenses.
unresolved_fields: single age_limit because Master and PhD limits differ
nationality_normalization: Official SEAMEO country names were normalized to the project's canonical country-name vocabulary, including Lao PDR -> Laos and Brunei Darussalam -> Brunei.
notes: UPLB is explicitly listed as a Philippines study post. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 75 is preferred rather than mandatory, so numeric English hard-filter fields remain None.

source_type: Official SEARCA DAAD In-Country/In-Region Scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: Official source states tuition and school fees, study and research allowance, printing allowance, stipend for food/lodging/incidental expenses, eligible travel allowance and insurance.
unresolved_fields: one scalar age_limit because Master and PhD limits differ
nationality_normalization: Official eligible country names were normalized to project country names. Myanmar remains an explicit eligible nationality.
notes: UPLB is an official study post for Environmental Science and Food Science. SEARCA portal deadline was extended to 30 January 2026; the DAAD portal deadline followed on 16 February 2026.

source_type: Official Visayas State University scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: The official VSU page verifies the Graduate Fellowship Program for Foreign Graduate Students and states that ten slots are available: five for PhD students and five for Master's students. The current public page does not itemise tuition waiver, stipend, travel, housing or insurance values, so funding_type remains Unknown.
notes: Foreign students may take any Master's program offered by VSU. Listed PhD fields include Animal Science, Agricultural Education, Entomology, Horticulture and Plant Pathology. Additional PhD/MSc options are conditional on the lifting of a CHED moratorium and therefore are not promoted into the structured fields.

source_type: Official Asian Development Bank Japan Scholarship Program pages
funding_classification_basis: ADB-JSP officially covers full tuition, monthly subsistence including housing, books and instructional materials, medical insurance and travel expenses.
notes: Myanmar is explicitly included among eligible ADB borrowing member countries. IRRI for registration at UPLB is an official designated institution. ADB lists a normal June intake and 31 March deadline but instructs applicants to confirm the applicable academic year/intake with the institution; therefore no invented 2026/2027 deadline is stored.
